races.paceDynamic: Celandine will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely joined by Hold A Dream and Paris Babe in the early stages to create a modest gallop. With only one true pace-setter, Celandine should get comfortable fractions without serious pressure through the first half. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Sky Majesty, Rosy Affair, Sayidah Dariyan and Flora Of Bermuda will be queuing up behind a steady pace. This race shape strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop when seven horses try to make their move from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If Celandine gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The sole pace-setter builds an unassailable lead while the hold-up brigade gets bottled up behind the moderate gallop. Early position proves decisive when the field bunches entering the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If Sky Majesty or Flora Of Bermuda get clear runs in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The higher-rated hold-up horses overcome the tactical disadvantage through superior ability when gaps appear late. Quality trumps position as the pace quickens genuinely in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hold A Dream or Paris Babe can stalk Celandine and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before swooping past a tiring Celandine. They avoid both the early pace battle and the late traffic that snares the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses fan wide simultaneously creating interference and blocking runs for others. The race becomes a lottery where any horse finding daylight can capitalize on the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Celandine must handle the pressure of making all the running after 203 days off the track
Sky Majesty and Flora Of Bermuda need clear runs late but face traffic with six other hold-up horses seeking same route
Hold A Dream's recent race fitness gives tactical edge over several returning from long breaks
Multiple headgear changes on Paris Babe, Magic Basma and Rhyme Dust suggest connections seeking improvement
William Buick on Sayidah Dariyan and James Doyle on Flora Of Bermuda provide experienced hands for tactical challenges

races.paceDynamic: Jakajaro and Apollo One look most likely to set the early tempo from their prominent positions, with El Bodon also capable of going forward if needed. With limited natural pace in this field, the leaders should get a comfortable time through the early stages without serious pressure. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (Double Rush, Addison Grey, Invictus Gold, Brian, Coul Angel, Indian Run, Sir Les Patterson) who will be looking to time their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can capitalise on the soft early pace and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jakajaro and Apollo One get uncontested soft fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The leaders build an unassailable advantage while the massed ranks of hold-up horses struggle to organise effective challenges. The pace-setters have enough in reserve to repel late challenges and fight out the finish between themselves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quality hold-up prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Double Rush or Addison Grey produce their best turn of foot in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, class tells as the highest-rated closers time their runs perfectly and overwhelm tiring leaders. Superior finishing speed proves decisive over race positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with multiple horses tracking closely at halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of position, favouring those with the strongest finishing kicks. Tactical positioning becomes irrelevant in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Indian Run or Brian finds significant improvement after extended breaks or returning to optimum conditions
scenarios.body: A less fancied runner benefits from the tactical setup or finds notable improvement to upset the main contenders. Fresh legs or returning form proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: If Jakajaro gets an uncontested lead through the first half-mile, he could prove very difficult to peg back
Indian Run returning after 264 days absence - market support would indicate hidden fitness work
Watch for Apollo One's early positioning after his break - needs to be handier than usual to capitalise on race shape
Double Rush and Addison Grey will need the pace to collapse or strong pace early to be effective from their hold-up styles
Any significant drift in the betting on the two main pace angles (Jakajaro/Apollo One) would reshape the tactical picture

races.paceDynamic: Alcarath and Thunder Wonder are the confirmed early leaders, with Alcarath particularly noted for making all in his novice win at Epsom. Both will contest the early pace alongside prominent runners Bullet Point, Botanical, Tycoon, The Lost King, Al Arbeed and Mister Winston creating an honest gallop throughout. The large field of 13 with multiple pace angles suggests a solid tempo from the start, particularly over this staying 1m1f trip at Newmarket. This pace setup strongly favours the hold-up horses like Fifth Column, Astro King, Erzindjan, Marhaba Ghaiyyath and Ancient Rome who can sit off the pace and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple prominent runners create sustained pressure on Alcarath and Thunder Wonder early
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will stretch the field and allow the closers to pick off tired leaders in the final two furlongs. Fifth Column, Erzindjan and Marhaba Ghaiyyath are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Alcarath or Thunder Wonder can steal a march and control fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and proves hard to peg back despite the closing kick specialists. Alcarath's Epsom win shows he can dictate when allowed to.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses into a sprint finish due to cautious tactics
scenarios.body: The horses tracking just behind the leaders get first run on the field before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Bullet Point and Mister Winston are best placed to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Mess
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and fade dramatically in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with mid-division runners finding gaps and getting up late. Any of the prominent or hold-up horses could benefit from the chaos that ensues.

watchPoints.text: Alcarath could steal the race if allowed uncontested early fractions given his front-running style and lenient handicap mark
Fifth Column represents the Gosden stable in excellent form and William Buick's tactical nous could prove decisive from hold-up position
The early battle between Alcarath and Thunder Wonder will determine whether this becomes genuine test or tactical affair
Bullet Point's draw wide could force Tom Marquand into aggressive early tactics that compromise his finishing kick
Mister Winston's recent Newbury win suggests Andrew Balding has him spot-on for this step back up in trip

races.paceDynamic: Night Raider and Five Ways will contest the early lead, with Night Raider's proven 5f pace likely to see him dictate terms from the front. Six horses (Asfoora, Quinault, Washington Heights, Rumstar, Jm Jungle, Frost At Dawn) want prominent positions, creating inevitable congestion and interference 2-3 furlongs out as they jostle for racing room. The strong pace from the leaders combined with the prominent traffic jam will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep through late. This race shape strongly favours the patient hold-up runners who can navigate the early scrimmaging and unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If Night Raider sets honest fractions and the prominent brigade clash 2f out
scenarios.body: The early pace and mid-race congestion creates the perfect setup for closers to find clear runs and overwhelm tired leaders. Patient tactics triumph as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses secures the perfect position without interference
scenarios.body: They avoid the worst of the traffic while staying close enough to the pace to strike decisively in the final furlong. Superior class tells through tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Night Raider gets easy early fractions with Five Ways keeping him honest
scenarios.body: The lack of serious early pressure allows the leaders to dictate a tactical tempo before quickening clear of the field. Speed holds sway over stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up dramatically
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the closers but the race becomes a lottery with multiple horses having chances. Form lines become irrelevant.

watchPoints.text: Night Raider and Five Ways clash early and set unsustainable fractions that benefit only the closers
Prominent horses Asfoora, Quinault and Rumstar converge 2f out creating interference and blocked runs
Shagraan gets too far back from the strong early pace and leaves himself impossible task
Beckford's Folly uses 3yo weight allowance to maximum effect with patient ride from Buick
First Instinct and Tom Marquand time their challenge perfectly through the inevitable gaps

races.paceDynamic: Into The Sky and Venetian Prince will duel early, creating an honest gallop from the start. Six horses want prominent positions (Gstaad, King's Trail, Alparslan, Power Blue, Oxagon, Distant Storm) creating dangerous congestion approaching the 2f marker. The honest pace will stretch the field, but the track configuration means those held up (Bow Echo, Needle Match, Avicenna) face significant traffic problems in a 15-runner field. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid the early scramble and kick from a good position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters fold and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for those tracking just behind the leaders to strike at the 2f pole. Traffic becomes less of an issue as the field spreads out naturally.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates enough gaps for late runners
scenarios.body: Bow Echo or Needle Match thread through as the pace collapses in front of them. The quality difference shows as fresher legs prevail in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Sky and Venetian Prince go too hard early
scenarios.body: Both leaders empty out badly, creating a muddling pace that suits nothing. Mid-division runners inherit a tactical mess with no clear pace advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Sky gets loose and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The Burke stable runner uses his 224-day break positively and maintains just enough to hold off late challengers. Venetian Prince fades but Into The Sky finds extra.

watchPoints.text: Into The Sky and Venetian Prince must be watched early - if they go suicidal up front, the race opens up completely for hold-up horses.
Prominent traffic jam featuring Gstaad, Alparslan, Power Blue, Oxagon, Distant Storm around the 3f pole could determine the winner.
Bow Echo's 217-day absence after three straight wins - if he's sharp enough off the break, he wins this.
Ryan Moore's choice of Gstaad over other Ballydoyle runners suggests stable confidence in the prominent racer.
Karl Burke's 26% strike rate in last 14 days makes both Alparslan and Billecart interesting for different reasons.

races.paceDynamic: Comical Point, Angel Of Anfield, Pilu, and Front Line Fury will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this 12-runner handicap. With four confirmed front-runners, the early pace will be genuine and likely above-average, stretching the field out significantly. The sustained gallop will test stamina reserves over the stiff 6f at Newmarket, with the leaders potentially coming back to the field in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces late, as the early pace battle should set it up perfectly for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too hard early and weaken markedly
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will string out the field but ultimately favour the patient hold-up horses who can quicken off the strong pace. Ten Carat Harry and Naval Light are perfectly positioned to exploit this likely scenario with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If one or two pace-setters drop out early, creating a more measured tempo
scenarios.body: A steadier rhythm would suit the prominent racers who can position closer without over-racing. Sovereign Spell and Kesta can get better positioning in a more tactical affair and have the class to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Angel Of Anfield or Pilu gets an uncontested lead after rivals fold
scenarios.body: With less pressure up front, one of the pace-setters could steal a march and hold on. Angel Of Anfield's consistency at the trip makes him the most likely to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If all four leaders go suicidally fast and stop dramatically
scenarios.body: An extreme pace collapse would bring the entire field into contention in the final furlong. Even the more one-paced hold-up horses could get competitive in a blanket finish scenario.

Naval Light has headgear applied which often signals improvement for the Burke stable
The four confirmed front-runners could go suicidally fast and set up a complete pace collapse

races.paceDynamic: Gamrai and Pride Of Donegal are the only confirmed front-runners in this small field, setting up a classic two-way battle for the early lead that should create an honest gallop throughout. With both showing recent form and strong tactical speed, they'll likely contest from the gate and maintain a solid tempo without going suicidal. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (Nightime Dancer, Nolton Cross, Daiquiri Bay, Oneforthegutter, Hopewell Rock, Military Academy) who will be relying on the pace scenario, while only Bellum Justum offers prominent racing from the pack. This race shape strongly favours the two front-runners who can control their own destiny, as the hold-up brigade will be at the mercy of whether the leaders go fast enough.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Gamrai and Pride Of Donegal maintain sensible fractions while the hold-up horses get caught behind a moderate pace.
scenarios.body: The leaders control the race without burning themselves out early, leaving the closers with too much to do in the straight. With most of the field requiring strong pace to be effective, the front pair can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders engage in a speed duel or one drops back, creating genuine pace for the closers.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks, with the class performers among them getting first run. Quality closers like Nightime Dancer and Daiquiri Bay thrive when given a target to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bellum Justum Bridge Move
scenarios.trigger: If Bellum Justum tracks the leaders closely and strikes at the perfect moment between pace and kick.
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the best of both worlds - close enough to the pace to avoid trouble but not committed to the early speed battle. McDonald can time his challenge to perfection when the leaders tire and before the hold-up horses arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer Produces Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one of the hold-up horses finds clear running with a devastating late burst.
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, superior class tells as a closer finds racing room and accelerates past tired leaders. This requires everything to fall right including pace, ground loss, and jockey timing.

races.paceDynamic: Stellar Vision, Splash, and Try Storm Cat are confirmed front runners who will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this 11-runner handicap. The trio will likely go hard early, with Velvet Rhythm and King Of Chaos sitting just behind in prominent positions, creating a genuine test of stamina over the 7f trip. The sustained pace will find out the weaker horses and set up the race for closers who can stay the trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Sierra Sands, Thaluna, and Cotai Lights who can benefit from the guaranteed strong pace and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain their aggressive early pace and create genuine splits
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will tire the leaders in the final furlong, allowing the hold-up horses with proven stamina to sweep past late. Quality closers with class will have the perfect setup to showcase their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but one prominent runner can track without overracing
scenarios.body: A horse sitting in the perfect position just behind the leaders can benefit from the pace without being caught up in the early burn. They'll have first run on the tiring leaders while staying ahead of the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate terms without serious early pressure from the other two leaders
scenarios.body: The winner will steal crucial lengths early and maintain just enough in reserve to hold off late challenges. Superior fitness or tactical riding allows them to control the race tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners engage in a speed duel that burns them all out before halfway
scenarios.body: The entire pace dynamic breaks down with all early leaders stopping dramatically, creating a sprint finish from the back markers. The race becomes a lottery for horses with any kind of turn of foot.

races.paceDynamic: Skipper returns from a winning front-running performance at Redcar and looks the only confirmed pace-setter in this field, with most others showing prominent to hold-up tendencies. Spanish Voice, Earl Of Rochester, and Advancing may sit close but none are natural leaders, creating a scenario where Skipper could dictate terms on the front end without serious pressure. The lack of genuine pace pressure should create a tactical affair with positioning crucial in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses will face a challenging task from what could become a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Skipper Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Skipper gets an uncontested lead and dictates a steady pace
scenarios.body: The returning winner can control fractions and kick when ready, while prominent horses like Spanish Voice and Earl Of Rochester get ideal positions to strike. Hold-up horses face an impossible task from a tactical race lacking genuine pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Spanish Voice, Earl Of Rochester and Advancing press Skipper from the start
scenarios.body: A faster tempo emerges that could set up the race for late closers, with the early pace creating more gaps and opportunities in the straight. Sterling Knight and Man Of La Mancha benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical nature becomes extreme with a bunched field turning for home, allowing the best finishers to show their class. Man Of La Mancha's Group class and Sterling Knight's high RPR rating become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get caught up in traffic or positioning problems
scenarios.body: A freely-running type like Twisting Physics or an improver like Final Night can exploit the tactical nature by finding a clear run. The race becomes about who avoids trouble rather than pure ability.
